A.name: A. Spatial Reference Errors
A.description: CRS, axis, coordinate frame, and spatial measurement semantics.

B.name: B. Spatial Data Errors
B.description: GIS file, attribute, raster, NoData, and data model representation semantics.

C.name: C. Spatial Reasoning Errors
C.description: Topological, geometry validity, and network connectivity semantics.

D.name: D. Spatial Analysis Errors
D.description: Aggregation scope, allocation, and spatial statistical analysis semantics.

E.name: E. Cartographic Errors
E.description: Classification, symbolization, and map composition semantics.

retrieval_policy: Use rule cards and the annotation guide to generate candidate labels first.
Filter by the candidate label's A-E major category before searching retrieval_text.
Fallback to all_cases.jsonl only when the major category is uncertain.
Do not include candidates.jsonl in verified retrieval unless unverified feedback is explicitly allowed.
